$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for this solution.
Everything that has to know the repo coordinates, the template list, the scopes
or the deploy-button URLs reads THIS file: scripts/gen-deploy-links.py regenerates
the README tables and the GitHub Pages site from it, and scripts/validate-templates.py
TO PORT THIS SOLUTION TO A NEW REPO: change `repo` below and run
Nothing else needs editing. Every Deploy-to-Azure URL, Gov URL and docs link is
derived from these three fields, so there is no second place for them to go stale.
name: Abstract Security — Microsoft Azure & Sentinel integration
description: Production Azure infrastructure for Abstract Security source and destination integrations: Event Hub collection, Sentinel ingestion, estate-wide log-stream governance, and automated per-subscription Entra app registrations.

templates.title: Event Hub (Source)
templates.summary: Everything Abstract needs to READ from Azure: Event Hubs namespace, one hub per log source, consumer group, the checkpoint storage account + private blob container the Abstract consumer requires, SAS and/or Entra RBAC auth, networking guardrails.
templates.notes: Deploy this first — every other source template consumes its outputs. Azure Policy never creates hubs, so hub names you pass elsewhere must exist here.

templates.title: Activity Log export (single subscription)
templates.summary: Streams ONE subscription's Azure Activity Log to the Abstract Event Hub. For a whole estate, use the log-stream governance pack instead.
templates.notes: Subscription scope, so it uses a Form view — createUiDefinition cannot bind a portal deployment to a subscription.

templates.title: Log streams at scale (Azure Policy)
templates.summary: Assign once at a management group and every subscription in it — current and future — streams Activity Log, resource logs, SQL auditing and Defender for Cloud to the Abstract Event Hub, and self-heals if a setting is deleted.
templates.notes: Three gotchas decide whether this works: the region rule (one namespace per region), remediation is not optional, and new subscriptions must land in the right management group. See docs/azure-log-streams.md.

templates.title: Microsoft Entra ID log streams
templates.summary: Tenant-wide Entra ID diagnostic setting: sign-ins (interactive, non-interactive, SP, MI), directory audit, provisioning, Identity Protection risk, and Microsoft Graph activity.
templates.notes: No Azure Policy can manage this — Entra diagnostic settings are tenant-level, so there is no per-subscription object to evaluate. Expect up to three days for the first records.

templates.title: App registrations (event-driven)
templates.summary: One central Logic App creates an Entra app + service principal per subscription, grants AND VERIFIES admin consent, writes the client secret to Key Vault, and assigns Azure RBAC on the target subscription.
templates.prerequisite: scripts/Deploy-AbstractAppReg.sh -a Bootstrap (Global Administrator, once per tenant)
templates.notes: Recommended over the policy variant: one tier-0 identity in one place, one run history as the audit trail, no per-subscription compute. Live-tested end to end.

templates.title: App registrations (Azure Policy)
templates.summary: Same outcome as the event-driven path, delivered through Azure Policy: a DeployIfNotExists policy deploys a deploymentScript container into each subscription which then calls Graph.
templates.prerequisite: scripts/Deploy-AbstractAppReg.sh -a Bootstrap (Global Administrator, once per tenant)
templates.notes: Only when governance mandates Azure Policy. It spawns a privileged container in every subscription, needs Owner on each, and cannot see the Entra app it created.

templates.title: Event Hub Destination
templates.summary: Where Abstract WRITES processed events: namespace, destination hub, least-privilege Send SAS rule, optional Entra ID (RBAC) delivery, Safe Mode networking.
templates.notes: Keys are never emitted in deployment outputs — fetch the Send connection string from the portal or CLI.

templates.title: Microsoft Sentinel Destination
templates.summary: Abstract writes to Sentinel via the Logs Ingestion API: Log Analytics workspace, Sentinel onboarding, Data Collection Endpoint, custom _CL table, Data Collection Rule, and the DCR role assignments.
templates.prerequisite: Create the Entra app first — scripts/New-AbstractSentinelApp.ps1
templates.notes: Use the with-app variant to create the app registration in the same deployment.

templates.title: Sentinel Destination + app registration
templates.summary: The Sentinel destination plus the Entra app registration, created in one deployment via a deploymentScript, with the client secret written to Key Vault.
templates.prerequisite: A user-assigned managed identity holding Application.ReadWrite.All
templates.notes: Re-running is safe: the script rotates a secret only when none exists or the current one expires within 30 days. This app needs no Graph permissions and no admin consent — it only receives DCR RBAC.

docs.title: Azure log streams at scale
docs.summary: Every Microsoft log stream, how each reaches an Event Hub, and which ones Azure Policy can onboard automatically — with the region rule and the two constraints that decide the architecture.

docs.title: Per-subscription app registrations
docs.summary: Both automation paths with their real trade-offs, the verified Graph permission catalogue, and the four bugs live testing exposed.

scripts.title: Log-stream governance driver
scripts.summary: Deploy / Grant / Remediate / Status for the log-stream policy pack. Remediation is not optional — DeployIfNotExists never touches what you already own.

scripts.title: App-registration driver
scripts.summary: Bootstrap / DeployA / DeployB / Grant / Onboard / Remediate / Verify / Status. Bootstrap is the one step no template can do.

scripts.title: Event Hub deployment (PowerShell)
scripts.summary: Menu-driven deployment of the Event Hub source stack, with preview and credential retrieval.

scripts.title: Sentinel app registration (PowerShell)
scripts.summary: Creates the Entra app for the Sentinel destination and grants both required DCR roles.

scripts.title: Template / UI contract validator
scripts.summary: Enforces what az bicep build cannot see: UI outputs match template parameters, no required parameter is unsupplied, and the UI model matches the deployment scope.

scripts.title: Deploy-link generator
scripts.summary: Regenerates every README table and the Pages site from this manifest, so a repo rename can never leave a stale button behind.
